## Scenario

Host/target operating systems, source version, and Environment or DSH mode.

## Steps and expected effect

Use synthetic host names, workspaces and files.

## Observed result

Include redacted diagnostics. Remove credentials, Web launch URLs, installer payloads and private conversation data.

## Recovery

What happened after reconnecting or restarting? Did any operation already affect the target?
